request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) expires **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf], issued by the Ausländerbehörde Stadt Musterstadt [party:pty_7jmdemeegmw0].

What to do before then:
- **Apply for the extension before it expires.** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf] If you apply in time, your permit counts as still valid until the office decides, under § 81 Abs. 4 S. 1–2 AufenthG (this doesn't apply to a Schengen visa) [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- **Ask the Ausländerbehörde for a Fiktionsbescheinigung** when you apply, as proof your stay remains lawful while the decision is pending [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- **Check your passport validity too** — it expires "2027-02-10" [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse] (not yet confirmed in Ordnung's record, so please check the actual passport date). A residence permit usually only runs as long as the passport is valid, and passport renewal can take months [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse], so it's worth sorting this in parallel with the residence permit extension.

If you don't apply in time, lawful residence status ends when the permit expires, per the letter [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf] — worth getting professional advice if you're at all unsure about timing.
